intent: Record as reviewed the ten balance, grant, charge and pricing rules the credit Context enforces and tests but the Registry did not hold.
observable_outcome: get-context credit lists the ten rules as reviewed, each citing its enforcing code and the test that proves it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An operator entry with negative credits is refused with ErrGrantLowersBalance unless it is an adjustment.
An operator entry is refused when its credits are zero, its trimmed reason is empty, or its user, operator or idempotency key is missing; its kind must be grant, topup or adjustment.
An entry that would take a balance below MinBalanceCredits is refused with ErrBalanceOutOfRange and nothing is applied; landing exactly on the minimum is applied.
Re-submitting an operator entry under the same idempotency key returns the current balance without applying it or writing a second audit entry.
An idempotency key already used for an operator entry is refused with ErrGrantKeyReused when it is presented with another kind or another amount, and the balance is unchanged.
Replaying a charge under the same idempotency key reports it as existing and leaves one cost event, one ledger entry and one debit.
A charge whose actual cost is unknown is recorded as an estimated cost event and debits no credits; the reserved ceiling is never billed as the cost.
A paid step may proceed only when the balance minus the credits billed for its reservation stays at or above the configured debt floor.
A cost or markup outside its billable range is refused with ErrAmountOutOfRange instead of overflowing, and billing rounds up, never down.
When account facts report the user missing or purged, a grant and a charge are refused with ErrAccountGone and nothing is recorded.
